essence: Tint replaces each pixel's black endpoint and white endpoint with two chosen colors, then linearly remaps all intermediate luminance values between them. Amount to Tint blends that two-color remap with the original image: 0% preserves source color, 100% produces the full duotone result. Effect Opacity mixes the effect result back over the untreated layer after the tint calculation.
when_to_use: replace black and white with colors
map shadows and highlights to brand colors
将黑白映射为指定颜色
manifests_as: The image reads as a luminance-preserving two-color treatment, with dark areas taking the Map Black To color, bright areas taking the Map White To color, and midtones becoming mixtures between them.

key_levers.name: Map Black To
key_levers.effect: Sets the replacement color for source black/dark luminance; changing it primarily recolors shadows and one endpoint of every midtone blend.

key_levers.name: Map White To
key_levers.effect: Sets the replacement color for source white/bright luminance; changing it primarily recolors highlights and the opposite endpoint of every midtone blend.

key_levers.name: Amount to Tint
key_levers.effect: Controls interpolation between the original source colors and the fully remapped two-color result; lower it to retain source color while adding the tint treatment.

key_levers.name: Effect Opacity
key_levers.effect: Mixes the entire already-tinted effect result with the untreated layer; use it as a final overall strength control when the mapping colors should remain fixed.

enums_to_verify.GPU Rendering (ADBE Force CPU GPU, 1-3): Unverified: likely selects an automatic/CPU/GPU processing preference or status; it should affect render implementation rather than the intended color mapping.

config_recipes.warm cinematic duotone: Map Black To: deep navy; Map White To: warm cream or amber; Amount to Tint: 100%; Effect Opacity: 100%.
config_recipes.subtle branded recolor: Map Black To: brand dark color; Map White To: brand light color; Amount to Tint: 25%; Effect Opacity: 100%.
config_recipes.full monochrome sepia: Map Black To: dark brown; Map White To: pale beige; Amount to Tint: 100%; Effect Opacity: 100%.

reasoning_hooks: At default settings, Map Black To is black and Map White To is white, so even with Amount to Tint at 100% the result can look unchanged; choose at least one non-default endpoint color before judging the effect.
Tint remaps by image luminance, not by hue selection: a saturated red and a saturated blue with similar brightness can receive similar output colors.

Amount to Tint blends source versus remapped colors before the final effect mix; Effect Opacity is a later whole-effect blend and is usually redundant if Amount to Tint alone is being used for strength.
Changing either endpoint recolors not only pure blacks or whites but all midtones, because every intermediate luminance is interpolated between both endpoint colors.
